about: The scene DSL's type: what a scene node's `font` names, drawn the same by every renderer (RFD 0009, goal 3). The web scene renderer (webviews/src/apps/scene/sceneStyle.ts) and the design check (cmux-tui/crates/cmux-tui/src/cli/ext/design_system.rs) read this file; scripts/cmux-next/gen-type-scale.py writes AppKit's copy (TypeScale.generated.swift, `SceneType`). Sizes are points (CSS px on the web) at the default text size; both renderers grow them with Interface Size as they do the chrome steps. `roles` are cmux's type roles, Apple's widget text styles, each drawn by an SDK helper (cmux-extension-sdk widget.ts; their sizes are tokens.ts `TYPE_ROLES`, which must match). `styles` are the Apple text style names a scene may still write, each at one size and weight, and the role at that size: one whose size and weight are a role's is that role by another name; the rest the design check names as a rename (`type-style`).
